acceptance_criteria: New Beads issue created. Title, line citation, RFC citation, fix approach all present.
close_reason: Gap documented in PLAN.md §Known Limitations #1: size uses encoded byte length (part.body_range.1) not decoded length; RFC 8621 §4.1.4 requires post-decode; this bead IS the tracking issue
description:
**What:** File a tracked gap issue (child of this epic) documenting that
EmailBodyPart.size is populated with the pre-decode (on-wire) byte count from
ParsedPart.body_range.1, but RFC 8621 §4.1.4 specifies it must be the
post-decode (charset-decoded content) byte count.

**Algorithm:**
1. Locate the relevant line in crate-jmap-mime/src/lib.rs:
     out.size = (!is_multipart).then_some(part.body_range.1 as u64);
   Confirm body_range.1 is the encoded length field in ParsedPart.
2. Read RFC 8621 §4.1.4 size field definition:
     'The size in octets of the raw data of the part.'
   Note: RFC says 'raw data' after CTE decode but before charset decode.
   Cross-reference with EmailBodyValue.value which is CRLF-normalized charset
   text — its length will generally differ from size.
3. Determine the precise impact:
   - For Content-Transfer-Encoding: identity, 7bit, 8bit — no difference.
   - For base64: decoded is ~75% of encoded.
   - For quoted-printable: decoded differs by =XX escapes.
4. Create a standalone Beads issue (NOT a child of this epic — a new root issue
   or child of a quality epic) titled:
     'jmap-mime: size field reports encoded byte length instead of decoded'
   with priority P2, type task, description covering:
   - The offending line and its filename:line
   - The RFC citation
   - The correct fix (call decode_body_value to get the decoded bytes, measure len)
   - The constraint: decode_body_value requires &[u8] raw bytes, so part_to_jmap's
     signature would need to accept them, or a new variant function must be added
   - Suggested test: create a base64-encoded text/plain part, assert
     EmailBodyPart.size == decoded_text.len() not encoded_bytes.len()

**Defensive programming rules:**
- This bead creates a Beads issue only — no code changes.
- The issue description must cite the exact line number from src/lib.rs (verify
  by reading the file before writing the issue).
- Do not guess at line numbers.

**Subagent instructions:**
Spawn one subagent: read crate-jmap-mime/src/lib.rs lines around
`body_range`, read RFC 8621 §4.1.4 size definition, then write the issue.

**Tests:** N/A — this bead produces a tracking issue, not code.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- A new Beads issue exists with the exact title above.
- Issue description cites the correct line number from src/lib.rs.
- Issue description contains the RFC 8621 §4.1.4 citation.
- Issue description describes the fix approach and its signature-change implication.
title: jmap-mime gap: size uses encoded length not decoded
